posts.title: Notes on my Linux system
posts.description: Recently, I became again a daily Linux user. Using Arch Linux, btw. I was a macOS user for about 3 years, which was a good OS by the way, but I missed a lot of features which was so much easier to do on the new environment, like tiling window managers, easier…
